name: @estoc/keystore
description: Encrypted did:key keystore — per-key PBES2 JWEs (v1) or one sealed seed with HKDF-derived Ed25519/X25519 identities (v2) inside a plain JSON document, opened as non-extractable Signer handles. Pure data-in/data-out, no filesystem IO; runs in Node, workerd, and the browser.
author: merely

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build
